letters.title: Happy
body: Hi you. I love seeing you like this, all light and smiling. It makes me so happy when you're happy  like actually one of my favorite things ever. Whatever's making you feel good today, I hope it stays for a while. And if it's me even a little bit, that means everything to me. Keep smiling, I love you.

letters.title: Sad
body: Motu im here for you no need to be sad. Take ur time i'll wait for u ml I love you on your worst days just as much as your best ones Bad days pass, they always do, even when it doesn't feel like it right now. Be gentle with yourself.

letters.title: Lonely
body: Even on quiet days, you matter more than you probably think. Distance can make things feel far away, but that doesn't make it true. Im here for you

letters.title: Exhausted
body: Put it all down for a second. You do so much, all the time, and it's easy to forget you're allowed to rest without earning it first. Today counts. Sleep, breathe, do nothing if you need to. Everything else can wait.

letters.title: Angry
body: Im sorryyy please naraz na ho

letters.title: Just need this
body: No reason needed, just a reminder: you're doing better than you think. Whatever today looked like, you handled it. Be proud of yourself, even a little. That's the whole letter. UR THE BESTTTTTT I LOVE UUUUUU
